CURRENT SCENE:
他又聪明又努力，旅行很远找到很多植物。比方说，灵芝和夹竹桃。他一吃各种各样的植物就知道能不能吃这些植物。然后，神农写他的主意。他喜欢植物的味道，特别是花。神农遇到了一个黄色的花，一吃就觉得不舒服。

ITEMS:

[I167] 【旅行很远】找到很多植物   correction: 旅行很远 → 走了很远   strength: error
  checker's note: 走了很远 is the natural way to express travelling a long distance here.
  rule card (collocation_selection, Vocabulary): Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <word/expression> does not normally collocate with <noun/action/situation>; use <correct> instead.  Her terms: Time + 期间, V.得很厉害, 着durative, no了for habit/routine
  her past correction: 所以他[走路旅行找足多→步行去找很多]不同的植物
  her past correction: [在他的旅行，→旅行中，]神农发现很多植物
  her past correction: 他[在这个旅程→在旅程中]尝了很多植物

[I168] 旅行很远【找到】很多植物   correction: 找到 → 找到了   strength: error
  checker's note: the completed discovery needs 了.
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 所以他[走路旅行找足多→步行去找很多]不同的植物
  her past correction: [在他的旅行，→旅行中，]神农发现很多植物
  her past correction: [看很多植物→看到了很多植物] — her note: 看look vs.看到see

[I169] 神农【写】他的主意   correction: 写 → 写下了   strength: error
  checker's note: ideas should be written down, using 写下了.
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 神农就想到了一个好[-的]主意
  her past correction: 神农[回→回到]他的家
  her past correction: 神农写下来他所有学到的[事情→知识]

[I170] 神农遇到了一【个】黄色的花   correction: 个 → 朵   strength: error
  checker's note: 朵 is the measure word for flowers.
  rule card (search_find, Vocabulary): 找 means “look for.” Use 找到 when the person successfully finds something.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person successfully finds <object>, so use 找到, not 找.  Her terms: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction: 神农找[+到]了一个很漂亮的花 — her note: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction: 神农在他[远走→远行]的过程中碰见了一个长得像太阳的花儿 — her note: “远走” indicates leave something behind and go to a place far away
  her past correction: 神农的朋友给[+了]他这植物 — her note: 了completed

items.explanation: 旅行很远 does not normally collocate with the action of going a long distance; use 走了很远 instead.
Finding the plants is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed): 找到了.
Writing down his ideas is completed in the story, so use 写下了 with 了 (了completed).
个 is not the usual measure word for flowers; use 朵 for a flower.
